tenderSchedule.title: TENDER FOR getting Annual Interest for consolidated deposit of Mysore palace funds deposited in centralized banks and RRBs For an total value of Rs.136.54 crore
tenderSchedule.description: TENDER FOR getting Annual Interest for consolidated deposit of Mysore palace funds deposited in centralized banks and RRBs For an total value of Rs.136.54 crore

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
RATE OF INTEREST FOR FIXED DEPOSITE SHOULD BE AS PER RBI AND BANK QUOTING HIGHEST ROI WILL BE CONSIDERED. (BANKS QUOTING LESS THAN 6.00% WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED
TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL EVALUATION WILL BE DONE AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Consultants experience in Banking sector NOT LESS THAN 3 YEARS
Consultant Banks branch SHOULD BE regulated by Reserve bank of India

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- COPY OF LETTER ISSUED BY RESERVE BANK OF INDIA

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Networth of the Banks --Public sector Banks Rs.5,000 Cr ,RRB's Rs.1,000 Cr

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-certified copies of the audited Balance Sheet for FY2025-26 and the relevant audited financial statements showing the calculation of net worth

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Public Sector Banks and Regional Rural Banks must have a record of profitability in at least two of the preceding five financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documents to be uploaded: self-certified copies of the profit and loss accounts for the last five financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Public Sector Banks: Net NPA must not exceed 1%. & Regional Rural Banks (RRBs): Net NPA must not exceed 8.32%.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-certified copies of the Balance Sheets and audited financial statements for the preceding five financial years, identifying the Net NPA figures.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Public Sector Banks: 2,000 crore in one year or 5% of net worth, whichever is lower & Regional Rural Banks: 200 crore in one year or 10% of net worth, whichever is lower

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-certified statement showing the total outstanding investment with the bank.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited Balance Sheet for FY 2025 -26 and the relevant audited financial statements showing the calculation of net worth
audited financial statements for the preceding five financial years, identifying the Net NPA figures.
Balance Sheets for the previous three financial years, together with the relevant CAR calculation/details
Profit and loss accounts for the last five financial years
